### 1. Scene
A cheese-pizza slice with Caesar-style lettuce salad and a small portion of cooked broccoli.

### 2. Vessel
A square dinner plate, approximately 27 cm across. Using a 27 cm circular approximation for the area calculation:  
**3.14 × 13.5² = 572 cm².** Plate shape and perspective add uncertainty.

### 3–7. Items, area, volume, weight and energy
The salad appears to include creamy dressing, croutons and Parmesan shavings. Areas below are non-overlapping estimates; dressing coats the salad rather than occupying additional plate area.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cheese pizza | 24% | 137 × 0.9 = 123 ml | 0.95 | 117 g | 270 | 316 kcal |
| Lettuce | 32% | 183 × 3 = 549 ml | 0.15 | 82 g | 17 | 14 kcal |
| Cooked broccoli | 8% | 46 × 2 = 92 ml | 0.60 | 55 g | 35 | 19 kcal |
| Croutons | 2% | 11 × 1.6 = 18 ml | 0.30 | 5 g | 410 | 21 kcal |
| Parmesan shavings | 1% | 6 × 0.9 = 5 ml | 0.95 | 5 g | 420 | 21 kcal |
| Creamy dressing | Coating | Estimated 20 ml coating | 1.0 | 20 g | 450 | 90 kcal |

**Area check:** 24 + 32 + 8 + 2 + 1 = **67% of the plate covered**, with the remainder mostly empty.

### 8. Sanity check
Approximately **284 g and 481 kcal** is plausible for the visible thin pizza slice, airy salad and small broccoli portion. The dressing quantity and pizza thickness are the largest uncertainties.
